integrity: Exact assumptions, conditional random-sum representation, tilted Berry–Esseen estimate, uniform Gaussian tail domination, random-clock mixing and sharpness argument are given in RESULT.md; verify.py tests finite consequences without purporting to prove infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to fair positive two-point step sizes, \(q=0\), fixed \(p\in(0,1)\), finite critical multipliers and the self-normalized centered noise rather than full position. Independent mathematical and historical-priority validation has not occurred. Prior broad random-index Cramer expansions may require additional priority comparison.
title: A sharp Mittag–Leffler quartic crossover for symmetric minimal-walk noise
